name: Scales Corporation Limited
summary: Scales Corporation Limited engages in manufacturing and trading of food ingredients in New Zealand, Asia, Europe, North America, and internationally. The company operates through Global Proteins, Horticulture, Logistics, and Other segments. It processes and markets proteins, such as pet food ingredients, edible meat, and offal products; and orchards, fruit packing, and juice concentrate. In addition, the company provides sea and air freight, and logistics services. Further, it provides insurance services; and operates cold storage. Scales Corporation Limited was founded in 1897 and is based in Christchurch, New Zealand.
